name: Penny
description: Teaches Jas and Vincent and lives in the trailer with Pam. Melons, poppies, and emerald make her smile.

seo.title: Penny — Tutor
seo.description: Teaches Jas and Vincent and lives in the trailer with Pam. Melons, poppies, and emerald make her smile.

stardew.intro: Quiet, bookish, and devoted to the town's kids. She dreams of a home that is not a trailer but never complains out loud.

heartEvents.title: Tutoring session
heartEvents.summary: Visit the trailer while she teaches Jas and Vincent — lend a hand.

heartEvents.title: Library reading
heartEvents.summary: Find her in the museum library and talk about books.

heartEvents.title: Bathhouse repair
heartEvents.summary: She asks for help fixing the old community bathhouse in town.

heartEvents.title: Spa reopening
heartEvents.summary: The restored bathhouse opens — a tender moment in the steam.

heartEvents.title: Trailer confession
heartEvents.summary: At the edge of the trailer she tells you she wants a future with you.

relationships.name: Pam
relationships.note: Lives with her mother in the trailer — complicated but loving.

relationships.name: Jas & Vincent
relationships.note: Tutors both children most weekdays at the library.

trivia: Melon in Fall is a loved gift — plant in Summer to have one ready for Fall 2 birthdays.
